settings.content:
Awkwardness gives me great comfort. I’ve never been cool, but I’ve felt cool. I’ve been in the cool place, but I wasn’t really cool – I was trying to pass for hip or cool.

A girl should be two things: classy and fabulous. I am convinced that there can be luxury in simplicity. I wanted to dress the woman who lives and works, not the woman in a painting. It’s hard to balance everything. It’s always challenging. My relationships with producers or photographers – these are relationships that took years. I can’t get sucked into that celebrity thing, because I think it’s just crass. My aim is to make the poor look rich.

settings.question: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.answer:
All S‑Brillet jewelry is handcrafted with care, so delivery time depends on the type of item you order.

Ready‑to‑Ship itemsIn‑stock pieces are processed and dispatched within 1–3 business days after your order is placed.

Made‑to‑Order itemsThese are customized pieces made specifically for you (outside of regular pre‑order collections). Production takes additional time, and orders are typically dispatched within 5-10 business days from the order date.

Pre‑Order itemsPre‑order pieces are handcrafted after a new collection officially launches. These items usually ship within 4–7 weeks from the collection launch date, depending on production timelines.

Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details and an estimated delivery window. Please note that delivery times may vary based on your location, customs processing, and local courier services.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide with some exceptions. You’ll see available options and shipping costs at checkout based on your location.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer:
Standard shipping rates are shown at checkout. Shipping is free for:

• All orders over $100 for Non VIP & Shiny tier

• All orders for Starlight & Galaxy members

settings.question: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
settings.answer:
Yes. If you need to change your shipping address after placing an order, please contact us within 12 hours of placing your order.

When contacting us, please include:

  • Your order number
  • The email address used for your order
  • Your new complete shipping address

Once your order has entered the fulfilment or shipping process, we may no longer be able to change the delivery address.

settings.question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
settings.answer:
No. Once your order has been placed, it cannot be cancelled or modified. We begin processing orders promptly to ensure your jewelry is prepared and fulfilled as efficiently as possible.

Please carefully review your items, sizes, quantities, and order details before completing your purchase.

settings.question: What changes can I request?
settings.answer:
You can only request a change to your shipping address within 12 hours of placing your order.

After 12 hours, we cannot guarantee that any shipping address changes can be made.

settings.question: When will I get a refund if I cancel?
settings.answer: If cancelled before shipping, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method (or to your IBAN if applicable) within 7–10 business days.

settings.question: How does the VIP program work?
settings.answer:
S‑Brillet VIPs are rewarded based on Sparkle Points and lifetime purchases.

There are 3 tiers:

• Shiny (starting tier)

• Starlight (unlocks at 700 points)

• Galaxy (unlocks at 1000 points)

Each tier includes exclusive perks, including:

• Bonus Sparkles

• Bundle discounts

• Birthday gifts

• Free shipping

• Free theme message cards

• 2-Year Warranty (Starlight & Galaxy only)

settings.question: Do my VIP points or tier expire?
settings.answer:
No. Your VIP tier and Sparkles do not expire.

Once you reach the Ultra Galaxy tier, your Sparkle balance will restart from 0, allowing you to begin earning Sparkles that can be redeemed for money rewards.

settings.question: What happens to my VIP credit if I return an item?
settings.answer: We will automatically restore any one-time VIP welcome gift or credit used in your original order for future use.

settings.question: Do you offer gift wrap or messages?
settings.answer: All S‑Brillet pieces come in beautiful packaging, ready for gifting. VIPs receive free theme message cards based on tier.

settings.question: Do I need an account to place an order?
settings.answer: No, you can checkout as a guest. However, we recommend creating an account to track orders, save your favourites, earn Sparkle Points, and enjoy VIP perks.

settings.question: How do I reset my password?
settings.answer: Click “Forgot password?” on the login page, and you’ll receive a reset link via email.

settings.question: Is my personal information secure?
settings.answer: Yes. We use SSL encryption and follow GDPR-compliant practices. See our [Privacy Policy] for full details.

settings.question: Will I need to pay customs duties?
settings.answer: International orders (outside of the EU or Singapore) may incur customs or import duties based on your local laws. These fees are not covered by S‑Brillet.

settings.question: Will I be charged VAT or sales tax?
settings.answer: VAT is included for orders shipped within the EU and Singapore. For other regions, any applicable taxes will be shown at checkout or may be collected by your local customs.

settings.question: Can I use jewelry cleaner on my S‑Brillet piece?
settings.answer: Only use non-abrasive, gentle jewelry cleaning solutions. Avoid harsh chemicals, especially for vermeil or rhodium-plated items.

settings.question: How should I store my jewelry?
settings.answer: Store each piece separately in a soft pouch or jewelry box to prevent scratches. Keep it away from heat, humidity, or direct sunlight.

settings.question: What’s your return policy?
settings.answer:
We accept returns only in the following cases:

• Faulty or damaged items upon arrival

Returns must be initiated within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and include original packaging.

settings.question: What items are non-returnable?
settings.answer:
We do not accept returns for:

• Made-to-order or customised pieces

• Sale bundles, free gifts, crystals, or store credit cards

settings.question: Who covers return shipping?
settings.answer: • We cover shipping for faulty or damaged items.

settings.question: How do I start a return or exchange?
settings.answer:
You can request a return or exchange within 30 days of receiving your order by contacting our support team via email with your order details.

If you’re a VIP Member, you can also submit your request directly through your VIP Dashboard. Go to My Orders, select the relevant order, and follow the steps to start your return or exchange.

settings.question: Can I get a refund instead of store credit?
settings.answer: Refunds are issued only in specific cases (e.g., return shipping reimbursement, pre-shipment cancellations). Otherwise, store credit equal to your item value is granted, excluding shipping/duty fees.

settings.question: What materials do you use?
settings.answer:
Our jewelry is crafted from:

• 925 Sterling Silver

• 2.5 μm Yellow Gold & Rose Gold Vermeil

• 0.10 μm Rhodium Plating

Each piece is ethically sourced and handcrafted with care.

settings.question: How do I care for my jewelry?
settings.answer:
To protect your jewelry and prolong its beauty:Sterling Silver (925):

• Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture.

• Use a silver polishing cloth to remove tarnish.

• Avoid salt water, sweat, and strong chemicals.

Gold & Rose Gold Vermeil (2.5 μm):

• Remove before showering, swimming, or exercising.

• Keep away from perfumes, lotions, and sprays.

• Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.

Rhodium-Plated Silver (1.0 μm):

• More tarnish-resistant than plain silver.

• Avoid abrasive cleaning or polishing compounds.

• Do not expose to chlorine or bleach.

settings.question: Where is S-Brillet jewelry made?
settings.answer: Our jewelry is designed in SIngapore and crafted in carefully selected international workshops that meet our quality and ethical standards. We focus on craftsmanship, materials, and responsible sourcing rather than mass production.

settings.question: What does the 2-year warranty cover?
settings.answer:
Our 2-year warranty for Starlight and Galaxy members includes:

• Manufacturing defects (loose stones, solder issues)

• Faulty clasps, broken chains from normal use

It does not cover:

• Tarnishing or fading from wear or chemicals

• Accidental damage or loss

• Third-party repairs

settings.question: Do you offer repairs after the warranty?
settings.answer:
Yes. We provide paid services including:

• Gold/rhodium re-plating

• Stone replacement

• Chain/clasp repair

• Scratch polishing

Contact us to get a quote.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer:
We accept:

• Credit/debit cards

• PayPal

• Apple Pay

• Amazon Pay

• Klarna (where available)

settings.question: Can I split my payment?
settings.answer: No. You are not able to make split payment between your product items and shipping costs.

settings.question: Do you support guest checkout?
settings.answer: Yes, you may checkout as a guest or create an account for faster future purchases and VIP tracking.

settings.question: Can I apply a discount reward and use VIP Bundle offer at the same time?
settings.answer: Most promotions cannot be combined. VIP Bundle offer are applied automatically at checkout.

settings.question: What does the packaging look like?
settings.answer: Each jewelry piece comes in our signature S‑Brillet box, with a soft protective wrap, fabric accessory, crystal and thank-you card. VIPs may receive additional free theme message cards based on their tier.

settings.question: Can I include a gift message?
settings.answer: Yes, VIP members can include a free theme message card. You can add this during add to bag before initiate checkout.

settings.question: Will I get notified when my order ships?
settings.answer:
Yes! You’ll receive:

• Order confirmation email

• Shipping confirmation with tracking

• Estimated delivery window

• VIP notifications (if eligible)

settings.question: Will my package include a receipt or price tag?
settings.answer: No, to protect gift purchases, we do not include prices in the packaging. You’ll receive your invoice by email.

settings.title: Suggest a Design or Vote on New Pieces

settings.question: Can I suggest or vote for new jewelry designs?
settings.answer: Yes! Join our VIP Club to vote on upcoming designs or submit your ideas through our “Vote New Designs” page.
